answer.answer: The sources provide details about several welfare measures for Transgender Persons: (1) Scholarships for Transgender Students [E01], with prematric/postmatric scholarships of Rs. 13,500/- per year implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment through Direct Benefit Transfer [E01]; (2) Skill Development & Livelihood programs to provide employment opportunities and develop entrepreneurship skills among transgender persons to improve their educational and socio-economic conditions [E01]; (3) A pension scheme in Sikkim state [E02]; (4) Housing and health measures [E02]; and (5) Vocational training programs [E02]. The sources also emphasize the need for creating safe school environments, curriculum addressing transgender issues, teacher sensitization programs, and establishing a reliable national database on transgender children [E01].
